## SEPTIC BURSITIS
Obtain synovial fluid for gram stain and culture to guide therapy.
## Likely MSSA:
Cefazolin 2 gm IV q8h [R]
## Likey MRSA:
Beta-lactam Reaction Assessment
Vancomycin 15 mg/kg IV q12h [R]
## Step down to oral therapy
Likely MSSA:
Cefadroxil 1000 mg PO q12h [R]
Likely MRSA:
Doxycycline 100 mg PO BID [DI]
< OR >
Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet PO BID [R,DI]
## _______________________________________________________________________________
References:
Up-to-date website
Sanford keyword: Bursitis, septic
Mandell chapter: Infectious arthritis of native joints

Guidance

Likely MSSA:
Cefadroxil 1000 mg PO q12h ($) [R] for 14 days
Likely MRSA:
Doxycycline 100 mg PO BID [DI] for 14 days
Trimethoprim-sulfamethoxazole 1 DS tablet PO BID [R,DI] for 14 days
